profile: BINIT_WAIT_EDIT=1 in both arms, private homes, Emacs and vi, Bash 5.2 and 5.3

The waiting tail plugin is loaded before the command executes.
The command receives the literal arguments and returns 37.
The false condition stays pending for a subsequent prompt.
metric: Visible echo of the queued text after the input write, before command acknowledgement. Include only effect-checked pairs.
